decisions.decision: Decision: option 3, plus a suffix on the course. 'Tantra Pro' stays the $99/mo app plan that includes the cohort seat. The $999 course is always called 'Tantra Pro Course' and never bare 'Tantra Pro'. The workshop funnel is renamed 'Tantra Funnel' and the nurture is renamed 'Tantra Flow'. Write this in the T-116 log. Then rename across app/src (workshop-cards.ts, card-education.ts, contrib-c.ts, schema.ts, funnel-visuals.tsx, masterclass-client.tsx, the s2/s3/s4 guides, funnel-os*.tsx, funnel-os-challenge.tsx lines 251/351, funnel-os-types/system.tsx), workshop-plan/playbook.html, the deck build, the library and T-071/T-051/T-273. Keep file names, guide ids and anchor ids (s2-tantra-pro-funnel, s3-tantra-pro-flow) and internal type keys unchanged. Run titlecase/embed/generate, check-guides, probe-guides, check-playbook-anchors and the leak probe. Then git grep -E 'Tantra Pro (Funnel|Flow)' over app/src and workshop-plan must return nothing. Commit, push and publish the mirror. Unblock T-071 and T-273 for naming.
decisions.why: Adi's 2026-09-30 ladder uses 'Tantra Pro' for the $99/mo plan and 'Tantra Pro course' for $999 (T-071 log, T-051 spec, T-273). The funnel and flow names came from the build and are not owner names, so renaming them breaks the fewest owner decisions. orchestrator-autonomy covers naming calls.
